book.name: Hibulu
book.title: Me niŋdi Hibulu metamdok mede youyemguk

content: Melikisedek adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kwanai-me loloŋnit hinek

Biyagoŋ hinek kuyoŋ, Melikisedek adi Selem yokwet diniŋ mapme eŋ Bepaŋ Wapum Loloŋnit adi’walaŋ siloŋ kwanai diniŋ talitimeŋ hatiguk. Adi-kuyeŋ Abalahamdi mapme memikŋiye widihikadakaaŋ yehikeleeŋ udanelune talipmeŋ wooŋ kimindeŋa kahaŋ timiŋguk.

Unduŋ tubune Abalahamdibo bomboŋ daneeŋ bop 10 boiŋa uŋaniŋ bop kubugoŋ aditok miŋguk. Wou Melikisedek wondiniŋ mebi inde’walaŋ mede foloŋ “Titiŋ Didimeniŋ diniŋ Mapme”, eŋ Selemniŋ Mapme wondiniŋ mebi adi “Kulema diniŋ Mapme”.

Melikisedek adi miŋbeunit mokit. Be mamaŋ papaŋ eŋ dadaŋiye diniŋ mebi dediŋ hatitalabugiŋ wendiniŋ kahatŋiŋ nemu nadiyam, adi’walaŋ hatihati adi tububihitnit mokit eŋ dapmandapmaŋnit mokit. Adi yadi Bepaŋ’walaŋ mihiŋiŋdok tuwolit dumuŋ heheŋ-me dapmandapmaŋnit mokit hatiguk.
Melikisedek adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ siloŋ kwanai diniŋ talitimeŋ doktiŋa siloŋ moŋgokuk
I kaneŋ hanilat. Adi yadi me loloŋnit hinek doktiŋa dadanik Abalaham adi bomboŋ kedehi hogohogok daneeŋ bop 10 boiguk gineniŋ bop kubugoŋ aditok miŋguk.

Indiŋ halibuguk, Lewi’walaŋ kobuliŋiyedi siloŋ kwanai titiŋdok yenindapmagiŋ. Kaŋ adibo metam noli nehi’walaŋ nohiye, Abalaham diniŋ yalakiŋiye kuŋgoŋ fiit nanaŋe bomboŋhik bop 10 gineniŋ kubugoŋ ugamali moŋgotdok Yodoko Medehik gineŋ yenindakalegiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ oŋ, Melikisedek adi adi’walaŋ yalaki gineŋ mu mintagukdi Abalaham’walaaniŋ bop 10 gineniŋ bop kubugoŋ moŋgokuk. Unduŋ tiŋa me wahu kahaŋ moŋgotdok gigit ulimiŋit u kahaŋ timiŋguk.
Unduŋ doktiŋa me loloŋnit niŋdi me fofoŋnit niŋ kahaŋ timilak u yohebi titiŋdok tuwot mu tilak.
Nai indidegoŋ Lewi’walaŋ yalakiŋiye kumuŋ tineeŋdi bop 10 gineniŋ bop kubugoŋ daneeŋ moŋgokiiŋ, eŋ nai uŋaniŋ fafaŋeniŋ hatibaak Melikisedekdi moŋgokuk.
Unduŋ doktiŋa nu indiŋ nadilat, Lewi adi bop 10 gineniŋ kubugoŋ moŋgotakdi Abalaham diniŋ yeuli hali nemek u Melikisedek miŋguk.
Diki indiŋ nadidok, Lewi adi dadaŋiŋ Abalaham’walaŋ yeuli hatune Melikisedek gut kimindegumuk.
Dumuŋ heheŋ-me koom hatigiŋ adi kwanaihikdi mu didimeguk

Lewi’walaŋ yalakiŋiyedi Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ kwanai tagiŋ wendi tubudidime kwanai tubune didimedapmawetuguk binek adi mindaŋkade siloŋ kwanai diniŋ talitimeŋ niŋ Melikisedek nabugoŋ mu mintawe tuguk, eŋ Alondok tuwolit moŋ. Siloŋyot diniŋ dumuŋ heheŋ kwanai doktiŋa Judahi Yodoko Mede yemiŋit.
Unduŋ doktiŋa dumuŋ heheŋ kwanai komidi wabilune kobulidi mintawaak, nai uŋaniŋ Yodoko Mede maaŋ komidi dapmalune kobuli mintawaak.
Gigitmededi me nagitak adi yadi Lewi’walaaniŋ mu mintaguk. Adi yadi mebop noli, dumuŋ heheŋ mu tagiŋ, adi’walaaniŋ mintaguk.
Wapumnik adi Juda’walaŋ yalakiŋiye gineniŋ mintaguk, u agaŋ nadidapmayam. Ala indiŋ, me bop wondi Dumuŋ heheŋ titiŋdok Mosesdi mu yoguk.
Tiŋa undugoŋ wondiniŋ mebi niŋ indiŋ dakalehinakalak. Dumuŋ heheŋ-me niŋ Melikisedekdok tuwolit yoŋit,
adi yadi folooŋnit mintaguk doktiŋa Yodoko Mede kameŋit wondok tuwot moŋ, hatihati fafaŋeniŋ hatak uŋoŋ Dumuŋ heheŋ tiŋa hatigukdi hatilak.
Unduŋ doktiŋa aditok mede indiŋ yohautaŋit,

content.text: “Dagoŋ Melikisedekdok tuwolit Siloŋ kwanai diniŋ talitimeŋ hatifafaŋeluwaaŋ.”

content: Jesu adi yofolok kobuli diniŋ kobumuŋ
Unduŋ doktiŋa Yodoko Mede koom yoŋit wendi saŋiniŋnit mokit eŋ folooŋnit mokit tuguk doktiŋa kelekuliŋit.

Biyagoŋ hinek, Yodoko Mededi nemek mu tubudidimedapmaguk. Unduŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋdi Yodoko Mede diniŋ kwelikoŋ gineŋ nadikunakunale folooŋ hinek tubumintanimguk. Kaŋ wendi nihitubu-lodaune Bepaŋ tubudulayam.
Kaŋ kobuli mintaguk uyadi yofafaŋe medenit mokit mu mintaguk, komihi adigili yofafaŋenit mokit Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ mintaaŋ hatigiŋ.
Kobuli yeŋ adi yofafaŋe foloŋ siloŋ kwanai diniŋ Talitimeŋ tuguk hatilak. Adi’walaŋ youkudip mede indiŋ hatak,

content.text: “Wapumdi ne wou foloŋ mede yofafaŋe tuguk u mu wabiwaak. Dagoŋ siloŋ kwanai diniŋ talitimeŋ hatifafaŋeluwaaŋ.”

content: Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, mebi unduŋ doktiŋa Jesu negoŋ mede yofolok kobuli diniŋ folooŋ Bepaŋ dut nihikiukuk hatilak. Wendoktiŋa yofolok kobulidi komi kalakapmeŋ tiŋa momooŋ hinek tilak.
Indiŋ hali buguk, komihi adi behiyedi kumulune mihihiyedi adi’walaŋ kayoŋkoŋ tiŋa kwanai titalabugiŋ, unduŋ doktiŋa feedi hatigiŋ.
Kaŋ kobuli adi hatihati fafaŋeniŋ hatilak doktiŋa siloŋ kwanaiŋiŋ tomboyoutnit haliwooŋ halaak fafaŋeniŋ.

Unduŋ doktiŋa adi foloŋ ulodiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋkade wiiŋ adi yadi yehiyoutela yehitutumbaaŋ yehitubu-kilitilak. Jesu adi hatihati fafaŋeniŋ molom hatilak doktiŋa helemahelemaŋ inditok yahehewe tiŋa Bepaŋ ninadilak.
Jesu adi siloŋ kwanai diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapum folooŋ hinek

Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, adi yadi siloŋ kwanai diniŋ Talitimeŋ Wapumnik uŋgoniŋ hinek, yomnit mokit, waliniŋ, kadakaniŋ titiŋdi hatiiŋ unduŋ mu hatiŋa dokoniŋgoŋ eŋ didimeniŋgoŋ hatigene kunumnehi yalakapmedapmaaŋ loguk hatilak. Undiniŋ kuyeŋ hatinimbune tuwot hinek tilak.

Adi yadi siloŋ kwanai diniŋ talitimeŋ komihi undiniŋ moŋ, adi yomnit mokitdi maŋgande helemahelemaŋ timeŋ netok yomdok dumuŋ heeŋ mindaŋ meeniŋdok hewek? Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, adi ne’walaŋ weleŋ eŋ folooŋdi nai kubugoŋ siloŋ tubune dapmaguk.

Yodoko Mede nai gineŋ adi meeniŋ nadinadihik gweheyehidi Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ wapuhi hatidok yoŋit. Kaŋ mindaŋ adi Yodoko Mede sigineŋ mede yokwambunda fafaŋeniŋdi Bepaŋ Mihiŋiŋ nindapmaguk. Biyagoŋ hinek kuyoŋ, adi kubugoŋdi walaniŋ hatiŋa wooŋ hatibaak fafaŋeniŋ.
